title: The Navigator's Covenant Reckoning
logline: A blind veteran navigator calls in an unwritten safe-conduct pledge from three system barons to grant asylum to the impoverished families of an expunged scout squadron.

roles.description: Blind veteran scout navigator holding original stamped brass safe-conduct tokens from a forgotten retreat thirty years ago.
Ruler of a wealthy agricultural province; smooth, aristocratic, determined to erase all memory of his youthful tactical flight.
A heavy provincial picket cutter intercepting long-haul courier vessels entering the estate system.
The surviving crews and families of the reconnaissance wing whose official battle records were expunged.
The hereditary council ruling the fertile agricultural gate systems.
A bleak fuel station in the border system where long-haul couriers stage jumps.
A decaying deep-space orbital platform sheltering the destitute families of the forgotten squadron.
The lavish orbital garden estate where the provincial assembly receives petitions.

public_situation: Destitute families from an unlisted scout squadron gather at {role:refugee_haven}, awaiting an answer to an asylum petition filed with {role:provincial_regency}.
private_truth: {role:veteran_navigator} holds proof that the provincial baron fled his combat post thirty years ago and bought his survival by promising the squadron permanent refuge.

beats.public_change: Notice boards at {role:refugee_haven} request an outside pilot to transport an aging veteran's personal effects across the border gate.

missions.reason: He needs a neutral pilot to retrieve a locked brass strongbox holding thirty-year-old safe-conduct chits from the station safe.
missions.private_fact: The box contains the personal signet ring the baron gave him as collateral when abandoning his command ship during the retreat.

beats.public_change: Provincial security agents raid transit archives at {role:waypoint_depot}, searching commercial manifests for historic relics.

missions.reason: The baron's advance scouts ambushed a veteran courier carrying the cipher key needed to authenticate the signet tokens.
missions.private_fact: He knows the baron has spent three decades executing other witnesses to the battle, and he is the last surviving officer who can testify.

missions.reason: He needs the pilot to buy an unmonitored optical decrypt cradle from an off-shift technician to read the recovered cipher key.
missions.private_fact: He spent his last savings three days ago to secure the decrypt cradle's warehouse serial number.

beats.public_change: Border stations flash advisories that all veterans carrying unverified frontier scrip will be detained at gate checkpoints.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the waypoint relay buffer to locate the baron's private communication logs and prove the detention orders are unlawful.
missions.private_fact: His old squadron didn't just retreat; they mutinied against their commanding admiral to cover the evacuation of the baron's unarmed convoy.

beats.public_change: The pilot's vessel breaks into orbital space above {role:provincial_palace} as the baron's heavy guard fleet prepares to deny entry.

missions.reason: The baron's picket cruiser locks tractor beams onto approach vectors to prevent the pilot from docking at the petition court.
missions.private_fact: The cutter commander hails offering one hundred thousand credits and an agricultural estate if the pilot destroys the brass signet strongbox.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot docks at the palace dais holding the brass covenant strongbox and evidence of the baron's historic cowardice.

options.label: Table the brass tokens before the full regency council to compel asylum for the veterans
Hand the signet privately to the baron in exchange for a massive payoff and trade license
Broadcast the full squadron mutiny telemetry to depose the baron and shame the council

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the tokens and proves the validity of the wartime pledge.
resolutions.summary: Faced with undeniable proof of his debt, {role:provincial_baron} yields. {role:provincial_regency} grants permanent agricultural land to {role:scout_veterans_cabal}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot hauled thirty-year-old brass tokens across three systems to make a proud baron keep a wartime promise.

resolutions.reached_by: The strongbox is sold to the baron or destroyed, or the pilot accepts the bribe.
resolutions.summary: {role:provincial_baron} destroys the signet ring and expels the petitioner families. {role:scout_veterans_cabal} is left destitute and scattered across border rocks.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the complete battle and mutiny records to the public assembly.
resolutions.summary: The cowardice logs go public. {role:provincial_baron} is stripped of his title by {role:provincial_regency}, and modest humanitarian relief is distributed to the families.

loose_threads.detail: The safe-conduct tokens contain a distinctive bismuth-gold alloy used exclusively by the admiralty's high command.
A municipal title office logged three agricultural estates transferred to an unlisted private trustee forty-eight hours before the asylum filing.
A drifting communications buoy in the border belt holds encoded telemetry recording an admiral's flagship withdrawing under escort.

radio_hooks: Provincial council hears emotional petitions from forgotten wartime veteran flotilla.
Border picket squadrons reinforce patrol perimeters around agricultural jump lanes.
Trading houses report volatile price swings in agrarian orbital leaseholds.

voice_direction.veteran_navigator: Blind, deliberate, and quiet. Pauses before speaking as if measuring distance by acoustic echo, keeping a flat and steady rhythm.
voice_direction.provincial_baron: Refined, dismissive, and nervous beneath aristocratic charm. Brushes off border campaign claims as exaggerated frontier folktales.
